coverage.summary: Applies to foreclosed properties containing one or more residential rental units. Owner-occupied two- and three-family units are not exempt from the 90-day notice.
coverage.other_conditions: Applies only where a property containing residential rental units has been foreclosed and acquired by a new owner.

evidence.quoted_span: Any person acquiring a foreclosed property containing one or more residential rental units

Foreclosure alone is not grounds for eviction in New Jersey.

result.notes: I removed the sentence saying notice is posted rather than delivered in buildings with more than 10 units. That describes how the landlord must give notice, which is conduct, not coverage. The 10-unit threshold changes only the delivery method, so it does not set max_units. I set min_units to 1 because the guide says the rule covers a foreclosed property 'containing one or more residential rental units'. I dropped the month-to-month tenant reference from the summary because it describes a type of tenancy, not a building, unit or owner. The guide gives no owner-occupied exemption, so owner_occupied_exemption_max_units stays null.
